preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= N <= 1000 for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of S and P, N, is between 3 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == N and len(P) == N for N, S, P in [tuple(input().split()) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the lengths of S and P are equal to N.

preconditions.expression: all(set(S).issubset({'0', '1'}) for S in [input().split()[1] for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, S contains only binary digits '0' and '1'.

preconditions.expression: all(set(P).issubset({'0', '1'}) for P in [input().split()[2] for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, P contains only binary digits '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] in {'YES', 'NO'} for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((return_value[i] == 'YES' if set(S) == {'0', '1'} and set(P) == {'0', '1'} else return_value[i] == 'NO') for i, (N, S, P) in enumerate([tuple(input().split()) for _ in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if both S and P contain both '0' and '1', otherwise 'NO'.
